item.title: A modern WSL instance management tool
item.description:
WSL Dashboard is a modern, high-performance, and lightweight WSL (Windows Subsystem for Linux) instance management panel built based on Rust and Slint, providing users with an advanced native experience.

When using it, users can easily manage existing distributions, create new instances, backup and restore data, migrate storage locations, and monitor WSL status and storage usage in real-time.

Core Features 🔗

  • Intuitive GUI Interface: Supports dark mode and smooth animation effects
  • Comprehensive WSL Instance Management: One-click start, stop, terminate, and log out all WSL distributions
  • Quick Access Tools: Directly open terminal, VS Code, and file explorer
  • Real-time Status Monitoring: Dynamically displays WSL instance running status
  • Backup and Recovery: Supports export as .tar or .tar.gz format, import from backup or clone instances
  • Storage Management: Supports VHDX migration to other disks, saving C drive space
  • Smart Installation: Install distributions from Microsoft Store or GitHub
  • RootFS Assistant Tool: Built-in RootFS download functionality for manual installation

Technical Features 🔗

  • High Performance: Based on Rust language, ensuring memory safety and zero-cost abstractions
  • Modern UI: Uses Slint framework, providing GPU-accelerated smooth interface
  • Low Resource Usage: Typical memory usage only 60-80MB, fast startup speed
  • Multi-language Support: Complete internationalization supporting 14 languages
  • Portable Application: Single-file executable program, no installation required

System Requirements 🔗

  • Windows 10 or Windows 11 with WSL enabled (WSL 2 recommended)
  • At least one WSL distribution installed
  • 64-bit CPU, recommended 4GB+ RAM

Installation and Usage 🔗

WSL Dashboard provides two installation methods:

  1. Pre-compiled Binary: Download the latest version of wsldashboard.exe from GitHub Releases and run directly
  2. Source Code Build: Clone the repository and build using Rust toolchain

Project Repository 🔗

https://github.com/owu/wsl-dashboard

item.title: Aura Factory Development Manual
item.description:
Aura Factory is a free and open-source desktop audio/video conversion tool developed based on the Rust language. It uses the modern GUI framework Slint to build the user interface and leverages FFmpeg as the underlying audio/video processing engine.

Aura Factory demonstrates the complete technology stack for modern Rust desktop application development, combining a high-performance system programming language with a modern GUI framework.

Project Overview 🔗

Core Features 🔗

  • Supports multiple audio/video format conversions
  • Provides advanced features like video cropping, resolution adjustment, frame rate settings, etc.
  • Cross-platform support (Windows/Linux)
  • Real-time progress display and conversion status monitoring
  • Version expiration detection mechanism

Technical Architecture 🔗

Overall Architecture Diagram 🔗

┌─────────────────┐    ┌─────────────────┐    ┌─────────────────┐
│    UI Layer     │    │   Business Logic │    │   FFmpeg Layer  │
│  (Slint GUI)    │◄──►│   (Rust Core)    │◄──►│  (Sidecar)      │
└─────────────────┘    └─────────────────┘    └─────────────────┘

Technology Stack 🔗

  • Programming Language: Rust 2024 Edition
  • GUI Framework: Slint 1.14.1
  • Audio/Video Processing: FFmpeg-sidecar 2.3.0
  • Async Runtime: Tokio 1.x
  • HTTP Client: Reqwest
  • File Dialog: RFD
  • Serialization: Serde
  • Time Handling: Chrono

Project Structure 🔗

aura-factory/
├── src/                    # Rust source code
│   ├── main.rs            # Application entry point
│   ├── consts.rs          # Constant definitions
│   ├── conversion.rs      # Conversion logic
│   ├── media.rs           # Media file analysis
│   └── utils/
│       ├── mod.rs         # Utility module exports
│       └── time.rs        # Time-related utilities
├── ui/                    # User interface files
│   ├── app.slint          # Main interface definition
│   ├── components/
│   │   └── components.slint # Custom components
│   └── statics/           # Static resources
├── build.rs               # Build script
├── build.ps1              # Windows build script
├── build.sh               # Linux build script
└── Cargo.toml            # Project configuration

Core Module Details 🔗

1. Main Program Module (main.rs) 🔗

Main Functions:

  • Application initialization and lifecycle management
  • User interface event handling
  • Asynchronous task scheduling
  • Version expiration detection

Key Implementation:

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
    // FFmpeg automatic download check
    ffmpeg_sidecar::download::auto_download()?;
    
    // Create Slint application instance
    let app = App::new()?;
    
    // Network time acquisition (for expiration detection)
    let network_timestamp = Arc::new(AtomicI64::new(0));
    tokio::spawn(async move {
        let ts = utils::time::standard_time();
        network_timestamp.store(ts, Ordering::Relaxed);
    });
    
    // File selection callback
    app.on_select_file(move || {
        // Use RFD to open file dialog
        if let Some(path) = FileDialog::new().pick_file() {
            // Asynchronously analyze media file information
            tokio::spawn(async move {
                match media::probe_media_info(&path_str).await {
                    Ok((duration_str, info_str, _)) => {
                        // Update UI display
                        app.set_total_duration(duration_str.into());
                    }
                    Err(e) => { /* Error handling */ }
                }
            });
        }
    });
    
    app.run()?;
    Ok(())
}

2. Media Analysis Module (media.rs) 🔗

Main Functions:

  • Use FFprobe to analyze media file metadata
  • Extract video/audio stream information
  • Format display information

Data Structures:

#[derive(Deserialize, Debug)]
pub struct ProbeResult {
    pub format: Format,
    pub streams: Vec<Stream>,
}

#[derive(Deserialize, Debug)]
pub struct Stream {
    pub codec_type: String,        // "video" or "audio"
    pub width: Option<i32>,        // Video width
    pub height: Option<i32>,       // Video height
    pub r_frame_rate: Option<String>, // Frame rate
    pub bit_rate: Option<String>,  // Bitrate
    pub sample_rate: Option<String>, // Audio sample rate
    pub codec_name: Option<String>, // Codec name
}

**Key Functions**:
- `probe_media_info()`: Analyze media file and return formatted information
- `get_probe_result()`: Execute FFprobe command and parse JSON output

### 3. Conversion Processing Module (conversion.rs)

**Main Functions**:
- Build and execute FFmpeg conversion commands
- Real-time progress monitoring
- Conversion cancellation support

**Core Conversion Process**:
```rust
pub async fn run_conversion(
    input: String,          // Input file path
    format: String,         // Output format
    start: String,          // Start time
    end: String,            // End time
    v_res: String,          // Video resolution
    v_fps: String,          // Video frame rate
    v_bitrate: String,      // Video bitrate
    a_rate: String,         // Audio sample rate
    a_bitrate: String,      // Audio bitrate
    v_codec: String,        // Video codec
    app_weak: Weak<App>,    // UI weak reference
    cancel_flag: Arc<AtomicBool>, // Cancel flag
) -> Result<()>

Progress Monitoring Mechanism:

  • Get conversion progress through FFmpeg’s progress events
  • Calculate percentage based on expected duration
  • Real-time update of UI progress bar and status information

4. Time Utility Module (utils/time.rs) 🔗

Main Functions:

  • Network time synchronization (for version expiration detection)
  • Time format conversion

Network Time Acquisition Strategy:

  • Predefined multiple domestic websites as time sources
  • Randomly select and attempt connections
  • Fallback to local system time on failure
const WEB_URLS: &[WebSite] = &[
    WebSite { name: "Baidu", url: "http://www.baidu.com" },
    WebSite { name: "National Time Service Center", url: "http://www.ntsc.ac.cn" },
    // ... Other websites
];

User Interface Design 🔗

Interface Architecture 🔗

Using Slint declarative UI framework, main components include:

  1. Main Window (App): Base component inherited from Window
  2. Card Component (Card): Reusable content container
  3. Tab Button (TabButton): Tab switching control

Interface Layout 🔗

  • Top: Logo and title area
  • Middle: Tab navigation (General/Output Settings)
  • Bottom: File selection, conversion control, progress display

State Management 🔗

Manage application state through Slint’s in-out property mechanism:

  • selected-file: Currently selected file path
  • progress: Conversion progress (0.0-1.0)
  • is-converting: Whether conversion is in progress
  • status-message: Status prompt information

Build and Deployment 🔗

Windows Build 🔗

# Use build.ps1 script
./build.ps1

Build process:

  1. Clean previous builds
  2. Use cargo build to compile release version
  3. Extract version number from consts.rs
  4. Rename executable file

Linux Build 🔗

# Use build.sh script
./build.sh

Build process:

  1. Create standard Linux package structure
  2. Generate desktop files and icons
  3. Create installation/uninstallation scripts

Build Configuration Optimization 🔗

Optimized release build configuration in Cargo.toml:

[profile.release]
opt-level = "z"      # Minimize code size
lto = true          # Link-time optimization
codegen-units = 1   # Single code generation unit
strip = true        # Remove debug symbols
panic = "abort"     # Direct termination on panic

Key Technical Features 🔗

1. Asynchronous Processing Architecture 🔗

  • Use Tokio runtime to handle file analysis and conversion tasks
  • Separate UI thread from background tasks to avoid interface lag
  • Callback-based event-driven model

2. Error Handling Mechanism 🔗

  • Use Anyhow library for unified error handling
  • Detailed error information feedback to users
  • Graceful failure recovery mechanism

3. Resource Management 🔗

  • Use Arc and Atomic types for thread-safe data sharing
  • Weak references to avoid memory leaks from circular references
  • Timely resource release and cleanup

4. Cross-Platform Compatibility 🔗

  • Conditional compilation to handle platform differences (e.g., Windows icon resources)
  • Unified file path handling
  • Platform-specific build scripts

Performance Optimization 🔗

Build Optimization 🔗

  • Enable LTO (Link-Time Optimization) to reduce binary size
  • Use minimal optimization level (-Oz)
  • Remove debug symbols and redundant code

Runtime Optimization 🔗

  • Asynchronous tasks avoid blocking UI thread
  • Reasonable memory allocation and deallocation
  • Efficient string processing

Security Considerations 🔗

Input Validation 🔗

  • File path security checks
  • Time format validity verification
  • Parameter boundary checks

Resource Access 🔗

  • File read/write permission control
  • Network request timeout settings
  • Memory safety guarantee (Rust ownership system)

Extensibility Design 🔗

Modular Architecture 🔗

  • Clear module boundaries and responsibility separation
  • Easy to add new file format support
  • Extensible conversion parameter configuration

Configuration-Based Design 🔗

  • Centralized constant management for easy maintenance
  • Parameterized build process
  • Configurable interface elements

Known Limitations and Future Improvements 🔗

Current Limitations 🔗

  1. Dependency on external FFmpeg binaries
  2. Relatively basic conversion parameter configuration
  3. Limited batch processing support

Improvement Directions 🔗

  1. Integrate more audio/video processing features
  2. Add preset configuration templates
  3. Support batch file processing
  4. Enhance error recovery and retry mechanisms

Summary 🔗

The project adopts a reasonable architecture design with good maintainability and extensibility. Through detailed code analysis and modular design, it lays a solid foundation for subsequent feature expansion.

License 🔗

GNU GPL v3 License

Contribution 🔗

Welcome to submit Issues and Pull Requests!

Contact 🔗

item.title: Share Sniffer Development Manual
item.description:
Share Sniffer (Share Sniffer) is a cross-platform cloud storage sharing link detection tool that supports validity detection of sharing links from multiple mainstream cloud storage services. The tool provides an intuitive graphical interface (GUI) and a convenient command-line interface (CLI), allowing users to choose the usage method according to their needs.

1. Project Overview 🔗

1.1 Supported Cloud Storage Types 🔗

  • ✅ Quark Cloud Storage
  • ✅ China Telecom Cloud Storage
  • ✅ Baidu Netdisk
  • ✅ Alibaba Cloud Drive
  • ✅ 115 Cloud Storage
  • ✅ 123 Cloud Storage
  • ✅ UC Cloud Storage
  • ✅ Xunlei Cloud Storage
  • ✅ China Mobile Cloud Storage (139 Cloud Storage)

1.2 Technology Stack 🔗

  • Development Language: Go 1.25
  • GUI Framework: fyne.io/fyne/v2 - Cross-platform GUI framework, supports Android platform
  • CLI Framework: github.com/spf13/cobra - Command-line framework
  • HTTP Client: Custom encapsulated HTTP client, supports retry and timeout control
  • Concurrency Model: WorkerPool pattern, supports concurrent task processing
  • Browser Automation: chromedp - Used for dynamic page content extraction
  • Dialog Library: sqweek/dialog - Desktop file selection dialog
  • Log System: Custom logging framework, supports multi-level log output

2. Project Structure 🔗

share-sniffer/
├── build/                  # Build scripts and test cases
│   ├── scripts/           # Automated build scripts
│   └── testcases/         # Test cases
├── internal/              # Internal packages
│   ├── app/               # Application core logic
│   ├── cmd/               # CLI command implementation
│   ├── config/            # Configuration management
│   ├── core/              # Core detection logic
│   ├── errors/            # Error handling
│   ├── http/              # HTTP client encapsulation
│   ├── logger/            # Logging
│   ├── ui/                # GUI interface implementation
│   ├── utils/             # Utility functions
│   └── workerpool/        # Worker pool implementation
├── launcher/              # Launcher
│   ├── cli/               # CLI entry
│   └── gui/               # GUI entry
├── screenshot/            # Screenshots
├── static/                # Static resources
├── .gitignore             # Git ignore file
├── LICENSE                # License
├── README.md              # Project description
├── README_en.md           # English description
├── README_jp.md           # Japanese description
├── go.mod                 # Go module dependencies
└── go.sum                 # Dependency checksum

3. Core Module Design 🔗

3.1 Application Architecture (app) 🔗

The application module adopts a layered architecture design, implementing a unified startup entry for both GUI and CLI. Mainly includes the following components:

3.1.1 ShareSnifferApp Structure 🔗

type ShareSnifferApp struct {
    app    fyne.App      // Fyne application instance
    window fyne.Window   // Main window
    state  *state.AppState // Application state
}

3.1.2 Application Startup Process 🔗

  1. Configuration Initialization: Get application configuration from global configuration singleton
  2. Fyne Application Creation: Create application instance using app.NewWithID()
  3. Window Configuration: Set window size, position, and title
  4. UI Content Creation: Build tab interface (check page and about page)
  5. Background Task Startup: Time synchronization and version checking
  6. Event Loop Startup: Display window and enter main event loop

3.1.3 Platform Adaptation 🔗

  • Desktop Platform: Use sqweek/dialog to provide native file selection dialog
  • Android Platform: Use Fyne native dialog, avoid calling desktop-specific APIs

3.2 Configuration Management (config) 🔗

The configuration management module is implemented using the singleton pattern, providing global configuration access. The configuration includes HTTP client configuration, detection configuration, application information, and supported link types.

// Config application configuration structure
type Config struct {
    // HTTP client configuration
    HTTPClientConfig struct {
        Timeout             time.Duration
        MaxIdleConns        int
        MaxIdleConnsPerHost int
        IdleConnTimeout     time.Duration
        RetryCount          int
    }

    // Detection configuration
    CheckConfig struct {
        MaxConcurrentTasks int
        DefaultTimeout     time.Duration
        RetryInterval      time.Duration
        // Long-running task configuration
        LongTimeout       time.Duration
        LongMaxConcurrent int
    }

    // Application information
    AppInfo struct {
        Version        string
        AppName        string
        AppNameCN      string
        ExpirationDate int64
    }

    // Supported link types
    SupportedLinkTypes struct {
        AllLinks []string
        Quark    []string
        Telecom  []string
        Baidu    []string
        AliPan   []string
        Yyw      []string
        Yes      []string
        Uc       []string
        Xunlei   []string
    }
}

3.3 Core Detection Logic (core) 🔗

The core detection logic adopts a combination design of strategy pattern and factory pattern, supporting dynamic addition of new cloud storage checkers.

3.3.1 Interface Design 🔗

// LinkChecker link checker interface
type LinkChecker interface {
    // Check checks link validity
    Check(ctx context.Context, urlStr string) utils.Result

    // GetPrefix gets supported link prefix list
    GetPrefix() []string
}

3.3.2 Registration Mechanism 🔗

// RegisterChecker registers link checker
func RegisterChecker(checker LinkChecker) {
    prefixes := checker.GetPrefix()
    for _, prefix := range prefixes {
        checkers[prefix] = checker
        logger.Debug("LinkChecker:Register checker,%s", prefix)
    }
}

3.3.3 Adapter Pattern 🔗

// Adapter adapter function, calls corresponding checker based on URL prefix
func Adapter(ctx context.Context, urlStr string) utils.Result {
    // Input validation
    if "" == urlStr {
        return utils.ErrorMalformed(urlStr, "Link cannot be empty")
    }

    // Get corresponding checker
    checker := GetChecker(urlStr)
    if nil == checker {
        return utils.ErrorMalformed(urlStr, "Link not yet supported")
    }

    startTime := time.Now()
    result := checker.Check(ctx, urlStr)
    result.Data.URL = urlStr
    result.Data.Elapsed = time.Since(startTime).Milliseconds()
    result.Data.Name = strings.TrimSpace(result.Data.Name)

    return result
}

3.3.4 Checker Implementation Example (Quark Cloud Storage) 🔗

// QuarkChecker Quark Cloud Storage link checker
type QuarkChecker struct{}

// Check implements LinkChecker interface's Check method
func (q *QuarkChecker) Check(ctx context.Context, urlStr string) utils.Result {
    return q.checkQuark(ctx, urlStr)
}

// GetPrefix implements LinkChecker interface's GetPrefix method
func (q *QuarkChecker) GetPrefix() []string {
    return config.GetSupportedQuark()
}

3.4 Worker Pool (workerpool) 🔗

The worker pool module implements concurrent task processing, supporting concurrency control for regular tasks and long-running tasks, improving detection efficiency.

// WorkerPool worker pool structure
type WorkerPool struct {
    workers           int
    queueSize         int
    taskQueue         chan Task
    resultChan        chan Result
    wg                sync.WaitGroup
    ctx               context.Context
    cancel            context.CancelFunc
    // Long-running task concurrency control
    longTaskSemaphore   chan struct{}
    maxLongConcurrent int
}

The worker pool supports the following functions:

  • Concurrent task processing
  • Long-running task concurrency control
  • Task timeout and cancellation
  • Result collection

3.5 HTTP Client (http) 🔗

The HTTP client module encapsulates network request processing, supporting retry, timeout control, and error handling.

// DoWithRetry executes HTTP request with retry support
func DoWithRetry(ctx context.Context, req *http.Request, maxRetries int) (*http.Response, error) {
    // 实现重试逻辑
}

// SetDefaultHeaders 设置默认请求头
func SetDefaultHeaders(req *http.Request) {
    req.Header.Set("accept", "application/json;charset=UTF-8")
    req.Header.Set("accept-language", "en,zh-CN;q=0.9,zh;q=0.8")
    req.Header.Set("user-agent", "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/141.0.0.0 Safari/537.36")
    req.Header.Set("cache-control", "no-cache")
    req.Header.Set("pragma", "no-cache")
}

4. 应用程序架构 🔗

4.1 GUI应用程序 🔗

GUI应用程序基于Fyne框架实现，提供直观的用户界面。

// ShareSnifferApp 是应用程序的主结构
type ShareSnifferApp struct {
    app    fyne.App
    window fyne.Window
    state  *state.AppState
}

// NewShareSnifferApp 创建并初始化ShareSnifferApp的新实例
func NewShareSnifferApp() *ShareSnifferApp {
    // 实现应用程序初始化
}

// Run 启动应用程序
func (q *ShareSnifferApp) Run() {
    // 实现应用程序启动
}

4.2 CLI命令行 🔗

CLI命令行基于Cobra框架实现，提供便捷的命令行接口。

var (
    rootCmd = &cobra.Command{
        Use:   "share-sniffer-cli [URL]",
        Short: "Share Sniffer CLI - A tool to detect and analyze shared links",
        Long:  `Share Sniffer CLI is a command-line tool that helps you detect and analyze shared links from various platforms.`,
        Args:  cobra.MaximumNArgs(1),
        Run: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) {
            // 实现命令行处理逻辑
        },
    }
)

5. 实现流程 🔗

5.1 链接检测流程 🔗

  1. 用户输入分享链接
  2. 适配器函数根据URL前缀匹配对应的检查器
  3. 检查器执行具体的检测逻辑：
    • 验证URL格式
    • 提取必要参数
    • 发送HTTP请求到网盘API
    • 解析响应结果
    • 返回检查结果
  4. 适配器函数处理结果并返回

5.2 并发处理流程 🔗

  1. 创建工作池实例
  2. 启动工作协程
  3. 提交检测任务到任务队列
  4. 工作协程从任务队列中获取任务并执行
  5. 长耗时任务使用信号量控制并发数
  6. 任务执行完成后将结果发送到结果通道
  7. 收集结果并返回给用户

6. 二次开发指南 🔗

6.1 添加新的网盘检查器 🔗

6.1.1 基于HTTP API的检查器实现示例（以115网盘为例） 🔗

// YywChecker 115网盘链接检查器
type YywChecker struct{}

// Check 实现LinkChecker接口的Check方法
func (y *YywChecker) Check(ctx context.Context, urlStr string) utils.Result {
    return y.checkYyw(ctx, urlStr)
}

// GetPrefix 实现LinkChecker接口的GetPrefix方法
func (y *YywChecker) GetPrefix() []string {
    return config.GetSupportedYyw()
}

// checkYyw 115网盘核心检测逻辑
func (y *YywChecker) checkYyw(ctx context.Context, urlStr string) utils.Result {
    // 1. URL格式验证和参数提取
    parsedURL, err := url.ParseRequestURI(urlStr)
    if err != nil {
        return utils.ErrorMalformed(urlStr, "链接格式无效")
    }
    
    // 2. 提取分享码和访问密码
    shareCode := extractShareCode(parsedURL.Path)
    
    // 3. 构建API请求
    apiURL := "https://webapi.115.com/share/snap"
    params := url.Values{
        "share_code": {shareCode},
        "user_id":    {"0"},
    }
    
    // 4. 发送HTTP请求
    client := apphttp.NewClient()
    resp, err := client.Get(ctx, apiURL+"?"+params.Encode())
    if err != nil {
        return utils.ErrorFatal("网络请求失败: " + err.Error())
    }
    defer resp.Body.Close()
    
    // 5. 解析API响应
    var result map[string]interface{}
    if err := json.NewDecoder(resp.Body).Decode(&result); err != nil {
        return utils.ErrorFatal("响应解析失败: " + err.Error())
    }
    
    // 6. 处理检测结果
    if code, ok := result["state"].(float64); ok && code == 0 {
        return utils.Success(urlStr, "分享有效", time.Since(requestStart))
    } else {
        return utils.ErrorExpired(urlStr, "分享已失效")
    }
}

6.1.2 基于浏览器自动化的检查器实现示例（以移动云盘为例） 🔗

// YdChecker 移动云盘(139云盘)链接检查器
type YdChecker struct{}

// Check 实现LinkChecker接口的Check方法
func (y *YdChecker) Check(ctx context.Context, urlStr string) utils.Result {
    return y.checkYd(ctx, urlStr)
}

// GetPrefix 实现LinkChecker接口的GetPrefix方法
func (y *YdChecker) GetPrefix() []string {
    return config.GetSupportedYd()
}

// checkYd 移动云盘核心检测逻辑（使用chromedp）
func (y *YdChecker) checkYd(ctx context.Context, urlStr string) utils.Result {
    // 1. 配置Chrome浏览器选项（性能优化）
    opts := append(chromedp.DefaultExecAllocatorOptions[:],
        chromedp.Flag("headless", true),
        chromedp.Flag("disable-gpu", true),
        chromedp.Flag("blink-settings", "imagesEnabled=false,cssEnabled=false"),
        chromedp.Flag("disable-plugins", true),
        chromedp.UserAgent("Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36"),
    )
    
    // 2. 创建浏览器上下文
    execCtx, cancel := chromedp.NewExecAllocator(ctx, opts...)
    defer cancel()
    
    browserCtx, cancel := chromedp.NewContext(execCtx)
    defer cancel()
    
    // 3. 导航到页面并提取内容
    var pageContent string
    err := chromedp.Run(browserCtx,
        chromedp.Navigate(urlStr),
        chromedp.WaitVisible("body", chromedp.ByQuery),
        chromedp.OuterHTML("html", &pageContent, chromedp.ByQuery),
    )
    
    // 4. 解析页面内容判断有效性
    if err != nil {
        return utils.ErrorFatal("页面访问失败: " + err.Error())
    }
    
    if strings.Contains(pageContent, "文件不存在") || 
       strings.Contains(pageContent, "分享已失效") {
        return utils.ErrorExpired(urlStr, "分享已失效")
    }
    
    return utils.Success(urlStr, "分享有效", time.Since(requestStart))
}

6.1.3 注册新的检查器 🔗

func registerCheckers() {
    once.Do(func() {

        // 注册电信云盘检查器
        RegisterChecker(&TelecomChecker{})

        RegisterChecker(&YywChecker{})
        // 注册123网盘检查器
        RegisterChecker(&YesChecker{})
        // 注册UC网盘检查器
        RegisterChecker(&UcChecker{})
        // 注册移动云盘检查器
        RegisterChecker(&YdChecker{})

    • 避免内存泄漏

// createContent 创建应用的主界面内容
func (q *ShareSnifferApp) createContent() fyne.CanvasObject {
    // 使用默认的Tabs布局 - 创建标签页容器
    tabs := container.NewAppTabs(
        // 添加检查标签页，用于检查分享链接
        check.NewCheckTab(q.window, q.state),

    tabs.SetTabLocation(container.TabLocationLeading)

    return tabs
}

7. 性能优化 🔗

7.1 并发控制 🔗

  • 使用工作池限制并发数，避免资源耗尽
  • 长耗时任务使用信号量控制并发数，提高整体效率

7.2 网络请求优化 🔗

  • 复用HTTP连接，减少连接建立开销
  • 合理设置超时时间，避免长时间阻塞
  • 实现指数退避重试策略，提高请求成功率

7.3 内存优化 🔗

  • 限制任务队列和结果通道的容量
  • 及时释放资源，避免内存泄漏
